shadcn/no-inline-styles.message: Inline styles are forbidden. Use Tailwind classes with Eolas design tokens.

message.spacing: Button controls its own padding and touch floors (44px min). Use size='sm'|'md'|'lg'|'icon', or apply margin/parent gap.
message.color: Button controls its own colors to guarantee WCAG AA contrast. Use variant='filled'|'soft'|'outline'|'text' and colorRole='primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'|'error'|'warning'|'success'|'neutral'.
message.shape: Button enforces standard design-system border radius. Do not override rounded-*.
message.typography: All-caps styling (uppercase) is strictly banned on buttons per DESIGN.md.
message.motion: Blanket transition-all is banned. Button manages its own targeted transitions.

message.default: Badge/Chip enforces high-contrast clinical status rules. Use variant='filled'|'soft'|'outline' and colorRole='primary'|'secondary'|'tertiary'|'error'|'warning'|'success'|'neutral'. Do not apply ad-hoc background/border color overrides (triple-tint anti-pattern).
message.typography: All-caps styling (uppercase) is strictly banned on chips/badges per DESIGN.md.

contracts.message: Card defines clinical elevation and containment. Use CardHeader, CardContent, and CardFooter. Never nest cards inside cards, and never use transition-all (use explicit targeted transitions).
InlineAlert must maintain standard rectangular shape with solid 4px accent bar. Do not apply rounded-*.
Toast must maintain standard flat rectangular shape (rounded-none) and 44x44px dismiss button. Do not apply rounded-*.
Tabs manage their own selection wash and active borders. Do not override backgrounds or apply uppercase styling.
Inputs own their touch floors (44px/48px standard). Do not override height dimensions directly.
Modal overlays must maintain standard surface styling, focus traps, and backdrop filters defined by Eolas UI.
Skeleton loaders support layout dimensions (w-*, h-*) and shapes (rounded, rounded-full) to mirror target components.
Shared motion primitives manage their own transitions and reduced-motion fallbacks per DESIGN.md.
CardContent permits internal spacing adjustments (e.g. p-0 for full-bleed media or custom padding).
Table cells permit text alignment (text-right, text-center) and tabular numbers. All-caps styling (uppercase) is prohibited.
